title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 18: Jonathan's covenant with David, Saul's jealousy and David's marriage to Michal.

questions.text: Whose soul was knit with the soul of David after he finished speaking to Saul?
questions.explanation: The soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

questions.text: What did Jonathan give to David?
questions.explanation: Jonathan stripped off his robe and gave it to David, with his clothing, his sword, his bow and his sash.

answers.text: A crown and a signet ring
His robe, sword, bow and sash

questions.text: What did the women sing when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine?
questions.explanation: The women sang, "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands."

answers.text: "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands."
"Saul is king, and David is his servant."
"The battle belongs to Saul and his son Jonathan."
"David has slain the lion, and Saul the bear."

questions.text: When Saul threw his spear, what did he say he would do?
questions.explanation: Saul threw the spear, for he said, "I will pin David to the wall!"

questions.text: Why was Saul afraid of David?
questions.explanation: Saul was afraid of David because Yahweh was with him and had departed from Saul.

answers.text: The Philistines had made David their king
Samuel had cursed Saul in public
Yahweh was with David and had departed from Saul

questions.text: Which daughter did Saul first offer to David as wife?
questions.explanation: Saul said to David, "Behold, my elder daughter Merab, I will give her to you as wife."

questions.text: To whom was Merab given as wife instead of David?
questions.explanation: When Merab should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

questions.text: Which of Saul's daughters loved David?
questions.explanation: Michal, Saul's daughter, loved David; they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

questions.text: What dowry did Saul ask from David?
questions.explanation: Saul said the king desired no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

answers.text: Ten talents of silver and gold
One hundred foreskins of the Philistines
The sword of Goliath the Philistine
A thousand sheep from his flocks

questions.text: How many men of the Philistines did David and his men kill for the dowry?
questions.explanation: David and his men killed two hundred men of the Philistines and brought their foreskins to the king.
